build_detection_train_loader: build a detection training data loader with dataset, mapper, sampler, and batch size from config
build_detection_test_loader: build a detection test data loader with batch size 1 for inference evaluation
get_detection_dataset_dicts: load and prepare dataset dicts for instance detection and semantic segmentation from dataset names
filter_images_with_only_crowd_annotation: filter out images with only crowd annotations from a list of dataset dicts
compute_num_images_per_worker: compute the number of images per worker from the solver batch size and world size
